description: See what your apps take up, and which supported files you can review for cleanup.
introTitle: Your apps, with the space explained.
introDescription: Compare reported installation sizes with the files Kudu can offer for cleanup review. Find the biggest opportunities before you clean.
privacy: Analysis stays on this device. Nothing is removed during analysis.
inventoryNote: Installed apps and known cleaner targets
cacheNote: Measured files from supported cleaner rules
scope: Partial view: installation sizes are reported estimates; reviewable files are measured from supported cleaner rules. These figures may overlap and are not added together. Excluded and inaccessible files, personal data and leftover installations are not included. Optional cache resets remain unselected until you choose them.
inventoryUnavailable: Installed app inventory could not be loaded.
partial: {{count}} cleaner rules could not be checked.
noApps: No supported apps or reviewable files were found.
installedNote: Reported by the app inventory. Removing an app requires its uninstaller.
personalNote: Your documents, projects, saves and personal app data are not measured here. Cleaner-source rows may represent shared tools, game installers or apps no longer installed.
reviewNote: Checks these rules again and opens a fresh Cleaner review. You choose what to remove. Cache may rebuild, some rules may reset app state, and game redistributable installers may be needed again for repairs.
scanError: App space could not be analyzed. Try again.
reviewError: Could not prepare a fresh cleanup review. Try refreshing the analysis.
cleanerBusy: Wait for the current Cleaner operation to finish before reviewing app files.
nothingLeft: No eligible files remain for this app. Refresh the analysis to update its sizes.
